title: Raw Vegan Cherry Cobbler
excerpt: Chef Ken Blue’s cherry cobbler recipe is a delicious, guilt-free dessert packed with the nourishing benefits of raw, plant-based ingredients. This vegan twist on a classic favorite will satisfy your sweet tooth!
content:
Ingredients

  • Filling Ingredients:
  • 2 cups of pitted cherries
  • 1 ounce of water
  • 1 pinch of cinnamon
  • 1 teaspoon of psyllium husk powder
  • 1⁄4 teaspoon of vanilla
  • 4 drops of fresh lemon juice, or to taste
  • Topping Ingredients:
  • 1⁄2 cup of chopped almonds
  • 1⁄3 cup of date paste (pitted dates processed until smooth)
  • A splash of vanilla

Method

  1. 1. Cut 1 cup of pitted cherries into thirds and set aside
  2. 2. Blend the remaining filling ingredients
  3. 3. Fold in the remaining cup of pitted cherries
  4. 4. Scoop the cherry filling into the dessert bowl
  5. 5. Press pieces of the topping between your fingers and scatter the pieces on top of the cherry filling
